provenance_rules.specification_intent: The implementation master is a design source, not runtime evidence; its fixture vectors are NUMERICAL_REFERENCE_NOT_RUNTIME.
provenance_rules.actual_source: source_snapshot/installed contains G45 landed postimages, byte-equal to reviewed G44 postimages.
provenance_rules.recorded_native: G43 source-bound controlled native story retained in G44; no new native execution for presentation.
provenance_rules.current_checker: G44 checker closure and G45 installed supplied result are separate from recorded producer source.
provenance_rules.schema_limit: Pointer and schema checks validate shape/navigation; semantic and contextual obligations require their named validators.

configuration.feature_interpretation: Prospectively configured bounded inspection relevance, source lineage, uncertainty and estimated per-branch compute cost; not measured CPU or probabilities.

prediction.meaning: Controlled prospective incorrect prediction of the observed constraint Boolean; safety enforcement is independent.

claims.title: Strategic comparison and actual bounded work
claims.claim: Gate 4 Reference adds finite multi-Root strategy comparison and bounded allocation of useful native work.
claims.argument: The strategy and allocation mechanisms enter actual Work results and local Root reviews, within the reduced contract.
limits: Full H-I-J mathematics and LGT remain deferred; no new model weights or authority.

claims.title: Preference changes the prepared offer
claims.claim: PRICE_FIRST prepares offer0; COMFORT_FIRST prepares offer1.
claims.argument: Both reports rank the same two valid offers, then each selection is consumed by current reviews, resolution and a prepared hold.
limits: PREPARATION_ONLY_NOT_EXECUTED; no booking, payment or seat reservation.

claims.title: Each owner makes a current decision
claims.claim: Removing Bank consent leaves the recommendation but produces Bank NEEDS_USER and overall MIXED without hold continuation.
claims.argument: A valid arithmetic recommendation does not provide the missing local permission; Client and Airline remain separately ACCEPT.
limits: Genuine in-process Root reviews and cross-root references; not proof of internet federation or legal agreement.

claims.title: Exact finite ranking
claims.claim: Feasibility, IR, strict Pareto and equal-exponent integer products give an explainable finite recommendation.
claims.argument: Original integer utilities and products are retained; both native offers are feasible, IR and Pareto.
limits: Configured utility units; not a probability, Nash equilibrium, incentive compatibility or universal fairness.

claims.title: Suitability precedes ranking
claims.claim: Known hard-false cases are excluded before score allocation; missing required evidence does not become zero.
claims.argument: Strict contracts, explicit missing sets and report recomputation separate malformed, unknown and genuine no-deal outcomes.
limits: Schema shape, arithmetic, contextual suitability and local permission remain separate checks.

claims.title: Attributable experience changes one raw prior
claims.claim: One source-bound incorrect prediction yields prior -62500000, effective_count 1, SPARSE; the warm lane consumes it once.
claims.argument: The saved prospective claim, actual Work original, G3 feedback, independent recording review and current history descent bind the sample to the consumer.
limits: Warm names an available-history lane; its statistical sample state remains SPARSE. No model was called or trained.

claims.title: History changes actual checks
claims.claim: Under the same PRICE_FIRST profile, allocations and performed optional checks change from 4/3 to 3/4.
claims.argument: The fourth price check moves from offer0 to offer1 and the final output lists the actual consumed quanta; offer0 remains selected.
limits: Seven optional checks of a 12-check catalogue; no measured CPU, price or outcome-quality improvement.

claims.title: Original spending is conserved
claims.claim: The 9-unit cap contains one already-spent initial check, seven optional checks and one reserved final consumer.
claims.argument: Budget reconstruction uses original policy and actual ledger usage; subsequent reports cannot reset cumulative spending.
limits: ONE_NATIVE_WORK_DISPATCH_UNIT measures admitted dispatches, not time, tokens, money or FLOPs.

claims.title: Allocated results reach the final consumer
claims.claim: The actual final PURE consumer receives allocation proof and produces an output bound to allocation identity, proof digest and original basis.
claims.argument: Explicit Work literals and completed results connect the allocation to downstream strategy and hold preparation.
limits: Acyclic proof/material dependency; no independent authority is created by the output.

claims.title: Original validity is not renewed
claims.claim: Current consumers check original source expiry even when reviews or wrappers are fresh.
claims.argument: Just-before-expiry preparation is retained alongside boundary/after/future/rollback refusals and a separate shorter-offer task.
limits: Saved current-at-event-time suitability does not restore current permission today.

claims.title: Retained history must qualify again
claims.claim: A previously valid history opening is not blindly reusable after time advances.
claims.argument: The warm lane performs current Root-approved descent and rejects invalid current history while preserving the enrolled basis and usage.
limits: History eligibility is narrower than physical truth; the trusted local memory boundary is explicit.

claims.title: Coherent false relations are rejected
claims.claim: Resealing a wrong quota, prior, result, root or offer relation does not make it admissible.
claims.argument: The verifier compares against independent original basis and source relations after outer integrity has been rebuilt.
limits: Refusals occur at named constructor/currentness/saved-relation boundaries; they are not all Firewall blocks.

claims.title: The checker is independently installed
claims.claim: Saved evidence cannot choose the checker implementation or substitute a transitive source body.
claims.argument: G44 P1 checks actual import origins, finite checker closure and exact recorded environment before saved semantics; archived source bodies remain inert.
limits: Requires a matching trusted environment; not an arbitrary clean-clone replay promise or hostile same-UID process containment.

claims.title: A genuine approval can have the wrong subject
claims.claim: A real same-Root recording ACCEPT for another subject cannot authorize this history snapshot.
claims.argument: G44 P2 binds copied claim/result material to cold originals; P3 binds recording input, transaction, subject and meaning references.
limits: Subject-specific evidence; a genuine signature or ACCEPT is not universal approval.

claims.title: Saved verification is deterministic without new authority
claims.claim: G44 Living, G44 Conformance and G45 installed supplied checks produced identical 1,151,634-byte canonical outputs.
claims.argument: Equal whole-file SHA256 and the named counters support deterministic saved relationship checks without new native execution.
limits: SAFE_DERIVED_SAVED_RELATIONSHIPS_AT_RECORDED_EVENT_TIMES; full native canonical replay is UNSUPPORTED_NATIVE_SCHEMA. Named monitoring is not OS-wide surveillance.

claims.title: Installation and presentation are separate
claims.claim: G45 landed the reviewed implementation at the pinned commit; presentation publication has a separate identity and review.
claims.argument: The installation report and result retain actual commit/parent/tree; historical NOT_CLOSED and TEST_SUPPLIED_PIN labels remain unchanged.
limits: Unsigned Git commit is not an external audit signature. No future publication hash is invented.
